description.narrative: (Liberia): Liberia is building upon a strong record of relatively free, fair, and peaceful elections in 2005, 2011, 2014, 2017, and the December 2020 senatorial election and constitutional referendum. The National Elections Commission independently administered the December 2020 election with drastically reduced donor funding compared to previous electoral cycles. The USAID Elections and Democracy Activity (EDA) is focused on three specific goals: 1) Increase the leadership capabilities of marginalized groups in the Liberian political processes; 2) Improve civic education and the sense of civic duty among Liberian citizens, young and old; and 3) Increase the capacity of the National Elections Commission (NEC) and civil society organizations to independently manage and observe all stages of the electoral cycle. EDA will support efforts to empower voters to demand accountability and to ensure that democratically elected officials follow through on constituent priorities. .Using FY 2022 funds, this activity will strengthen the National Elections Commission; assist civil society to deliver countrywide voter education of critical electoral and political issues; re-introduce civic education into Liberian schools; increase women and youth engagement in elections and political processes, including candidate training for female candidates running in 2023; support election reform efforts; and prepare the electorate for future electoral cycles. This activity will support the Ministry of Education's rollout of the 2014 National Curriculum on Citizen Education and will update and finalize the proposed civic education curriculum, support a pilot introduction of the curriculum, adapt the curriculum as necessary, and then scale up the curriculum's use in more Liberian schools.
